turns: Fix the event dispatcher bug in events/dispatcher.py: when a listener unsubscribes itself during emit(), the next listener in order is silently skipped. Every listener subscribed at the moment emit() starts must be invoked exactly once for that event. Scope: events/dispatcher.py only Acceptance criteria: self-unsubscribing listeners do not cause later listeners to be skipped; every test under tests/ passes Verify with: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v Stop when the tests pass.
